long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Istanbul's Fatih district to a family that migrated from Yugoslavia, Muzaffer Yıldırım began working at twelve and later studied at the Sports Academy. He progressed from Vakko Gym and Philip Morris to a decade leading Alarko Tourism, gaining operating experience across fitness, hospitality and entertainment.

After leaving Alarko, Yıldırım and Menderes Utku used an early restaurant venture to help finance cinema investment. Mars grew from a two-person startup into Turkey's leading multiplex operator, supported by successive private-equity partners. He later sold his remaining cinema interest and concentrated on NuLook, producing Turkish films and digital series while developing The Stay hotels and other cultural, hospitality and property ventures.

He later sold his remaining cinema interest and concentrated on NuLook, producing Turkish films and digital series while developing The Stay hotels and other cultural, hospitality and property ventures.
